verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for an IP registry that runs digital filing and search services, since such offices can plausibly offer developer APIs with keys. The evidence shows no way to issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. The only credential described is a human One Login account for patent filing, and the trade-mark search host walls keyless agents at robots.txt, with no mention of API keys, tokens, or scopes.
